items.title: Connecting Kashmir: Building the Infrastructure for Growth
items.summary: 17 OCT 2026 11:21AM by PIB Delhi Jammu and Kashmir's challenging terrain is steadily yielding to a new era of connectivity. The Udhampur–Srinagar–Baramulla Rail Link has connected the valley to India's rail network. Its centrepiece, the Chenab Bridge, stands as the world's highest railway arch bridge. Expanded Vande Bharat services are improving passenger mobility.

facts.text: Built at a cost of ₹43,780 crore , the USBRL project covers the districts of Udhampur , Reasi , Ramban , Srinagar , Anantnag , Pulwama , Budgam and Baramulla of Jammu and Kashmir.
As part of the USBRL project, over 215 km (including a tunnel and 320 bridges) of roads have been constructed, which are useful for communities.
The project has generated more than 5 crore man-days of employment.
Image 1: Vande Bharat Express, Jammu and Kashmir The Vande Bharat Express in Jammu and Kashmir first began operations in June 2025, between Katra and Srinagar.

facts.text: 17 OCT 2026 3:45PM by PIB Delhi The First Stakeholder Consultation Meeting of the Climate Science into Services for India Forum (CSSIF) was held at IITM, Pune, on 17 October 2026.

IITM Pune; 17.10.2026: The Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM), Pune, under the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), organised the First Stakeholder Consultation Meeting of the Climate Science into Services for India Forum (CSSIF) on 17 October 2026 at its campus in Pune.
The consultation focused on the role of climate science in developing relevant climate services and strengthening the application of weather and climate information across different sectors.
Dadhwal, Former Director, Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), addressed the gathering as the Chief Guest.
